name: tour-ticket-compare
description: SEO-focused independent ticket comparison affiliate site with verified provider routes.

scripts.deploy: node -e "console.log('Production is Cloudflare Worker tourticketcompare-live. Run npm run check:worker, then upload /tmp/tourticketcompare-worker.js to that Worker preserving bindings. See README.md#deployment.')"
scripts.deploy:pages:safe: npm run events:validate:prod && wrangler pages deploy public
scripts.demand:export: wrangler d1 execute tourticketcompare-demand --remote --command "SELECT * FROM email_subscribers"
scripts.events:update: python3 scripts/csv-to-events.py && python3 scripts/validate-events.py && python3 scripts/partition-events.py && python3 scripts/sync-events-data.py
